entries.round: task:Implement Task 4.1: Shared Context Memory Store. 1. Create a new file 'context_store.py'. 2. Define a class 'ContextStore' that manages thread-safe access to a shared dictionary. 3. Use this ContextStore in Orchestrator to store 'proposals', 'challenges', 'artifacts', and 'errors'. 4. Update Orchestrator to pass this store to agents so they can query prior outputs. IMPORTANT: Wrap the code in <write_file path="context_store.py"> tags and wrap the modified orchestrator.py in <write_file path="orchestrator.py"> tags.
